about: I'm an animation and 3D computer graphics practitioner based in Surabaya, Indonesia, holding a background from SMKN 2 Surabaya (Jurusan Animasi). Since 2020, I have immersed myself in the art of 3D modeling, hard-surface precision, architectural rendering, and digital world-building.

Over the past few years, I have executed more than 10 freelance 3D commissions for international clients, delivering game-ready props, stylized fantasy dioramas, and photorealistic architectural visualizations (Archviz) using Blender, Autodesk Maya, and Substance 3D Painter.

What sets my work apart is my cross-disciplinary versatility: alongside 3D and CGI, I create high-impact graphic campaigns and video productions (having directed 30+ property reels and marketing assets at PT Wong Bejo Joyo), as well as interactive UI/UX interfaces for game HUDs and modern web platforms. I thrive at the frontier where visual art meets functional software.

experience.description: Completed over 10 international 3D modeling and visualization projects. Created game-ready low-poly and stylized 3D assets, modular environment sets, and architectural renderings. Managed the end-to-end pipeline from conceptual geometry and high-to-low poly baking to UV unwrap, PBR texturing, and photorealistic lighting.

Produced and directed 30+ high-production real estate promotional videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok. Spearheaded weekly content strategies, hashtag research, and analytics optimization, achieving a 45% lift in social engagement rate. Collaborated with marketing teams on paid Meta Ads campaigns.

Regular participant in global 3D modeling challenges, topology reviews, and asset critiques within the Blender community. Active contributor in the Hidden Dev community, collaborating on web UI/UX projects, automation tools, and front-end code experiments.

projects.title: Neo-Archviz: Brutalist Sanctuary
projects.summary: Photorealistic architectural visualization of a brutalist luxury residence with panoramic forest vistas, custom PBR concrete shaders, and cinematic morning sunbeams.
projects.description: A comprehensive study in high-end architectural rendering and mood crafting. Featuring custom procedural board-formed concrete textures, accurate IES interior lighting, mid-century Scandinavian furniture modeling, and Cycles volumetric ray-tracing.

projects.title: Aethel-4 Industrial Combat Drone
projects.summary: High-poly tactical UGV tracked combat drone with detailed mechanical assemblies, weathered decals, and high-to-low poly baked normal maps.
projects.description: Modeled using non-destructive subdivision workflows in Blender and Autodesk Maya. Textured inside Substance 3D Painter with multi-layered edge scratches, hydraulic fluid stains, and industrial warning stencils. Rendered in studio lighting.

projects.title: Moonlit Torii Shrine Island
projects.summary: Enchanted floating Japanese Torii island environment with glowing sakura blossom canopy, stylized waterfalls, and hand-painted lighting ambiance.
projects.description: Award-winning stylized diorama designed for real-time game engines. Includes custom stylized leaf particle clusters, emissive lantern shaders, stone stairs, and whimsical celestial clouds inspired by Japanese anime aesthetics.
